'''Fan projects''' are unofficial fan efforts to improve or preserve resources for [[Star Wars CCG]], including high-resolution card scans, print-ready remastered card files, and play tools built from those scans.

== HiRez scanning project ==

On 20 May 2017, [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]] announced a project on the Star Wars CCG Forums to assemble a 600 dpi image archive of Star Wars CCG cards.<ref name="t65510" /> The thread is titled HiRez scanning duty (**Completed!**).<ref name="t65510" />

The scans are published in a Google Drive folder, [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG].<ref name="drive" /><ref name="t65510" /> On 26 September 2021, strangewayes wrote that the set folders had been moved into one master folder so the collection could be shared as a single link, and that the first post of the thread had been updated with that link.<ref name="t65510-2021" />

The folder contains TIFF scans of the [[Decipher]] sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Theed Palace]], including [[Reflections II]], [[Reflections III]] and Alternate Images, together with Premium product cards, Errata, Virtual Sets 0–9, card backs and a printing guide titled How To Print Cards.pdf.<ref name="drive" /> strangewayes described the work as an entire 600 dpi SWCCG image archive.<ref name="t65510" />

On 21 February 2023, strangewayes last edited the first post and wrote that he would continue to maintain the download links.<ref name="t65510" />

== Star Wars CCG (HiRez) ==

[https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2900102719 Star Wars CCG (HiRez)] is a [[Tabletop Simulator]] Workshop table published by [[Tolban]]. The Workshop credits state that the high-resolution card scans are from strangewayes, and they link the HiRez scanning duty forum thread.<ref name="hirez" />

== Print-ready card files ==

On 9 January 2021, the Reddit community r/starwarsccgalters published a stickied post titled MPC Print Ready Cards - Links to drives and community disclaimer, written by the moderator account sharedmod.<ref name="mpc-post" /> The post lists Google Drive folders of MPC print-ready card files, and states that the cards are not tournament legal and are not endorsed by the [[Players Committee]].<ref name="mpc-post" /> It describes the files as quality proxies for kitchen-table play, dream cards and printable fan expansions, including as an alternative when some cards have become prohibitively expensive.<ref name="mpc-post" /> The post also notes that, at that time, MPC was refusing to print anything recognizable as Star Wars intellectual property, and that the authors were investigating other print options.<ref name="mpc-post" />

=== Decipher cards and modified Virtual cards ===

[https://drive.google.com/embeddedfolderview?id=1UovqVal-2TWJVyf9tmB4Cw35W30hJo_f Shared SWCCG], listed in the post under the name Andyt563 for [[Andrew Thomas]], was described as fully remastered MPC-ready cards from [[Premiere]] through [[Coruscant]], as ongoing work, with all images and text replaced, together with playmats sized for printing with most print-your-own playmat suppliers.<ref name="mpc-post" /><ref name="andyt-drive" /> The folder contains set folders numbered 01 to 15 for the [[Decipher]] sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Theed Palace]], including [[Reflections II]], [[Reflections III]] and Premium product, a Templates folder, and Light Side and Dark Side playmat JPEG files.<ref name="andyt-drive" />

[https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1tDJC5bZ7Ul9B_-QjMXl38aw2k8trN4-R SW:CCG], listed in the post under the name Chrknudsen for [[Christian Knudsen]], was described as a mix of staple cards and [[Virtual cards]], tried with Printer Studio and MPC.<ref name="mpc-post" /><ref name="chrknudsen-drive" />

[https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1q2ogJZtXe9kHPib6NKCC8UjM90ziEnkb Ubik_Fresh's drive], titled SWCCG Mains & Toys Duel Decks, was described as an MPC-ready pair of dueling Mains & Toys decks. The post says the versions without prequel cards are fully remastered with cards from Andyt563, that prequel cards would be added when available, that the decks are made to be balanced and played against each other, that the deck lists are based on Reinhart's design, and that errata text is used where applicable. It also lists Empire Strikes Back dueling decks, based on a list at Star Wars Duel Decks.<ref name="mpc-post" /><ref name="ubik-drive" />

[https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OLkvyYpyP_8T-ngF3XUK4DumXQcqEZRf Scoops Ahoy's drive], titled Extended Arts, was described as a selection of Extended Art alters, in Virtual and regular versions.<ref name="mpc-post" /><ref name="scoops-drive" />

[https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1YsZlSypfeHna7HeewuUKtaMTtRTNlSK_ Izzarp's drive], titled Custom Alters, was described as staple cards, all MPC ready.<ref name="mpc-post" /><ref name="izzarp-drive" />

=== Fan expansions ===

[https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1cTwMv0bo80xQBYlY-yttlHH4LdF9viAT Anachrokate's Hutt Space Fan Expansion], in a folder titled HUTT SPACE (near complete) 2021 Full Expansion Set, was described as a 300-card standalone expansion.<ref name="mpc-post" /><ref name="anachrokate-drive" />

[https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1v6o_4HUbgHNPKc8y-DWLZl7x3Il70L5n Lhamo66's Rogue One & Mandalorian Fan Expansion], in a folder titled Lhamo's SWCCG Expansions, was described as a full set of cards based on the television series ''The Mandalorian'', with Rogue One starter decks for Dark Side and Light Side, all MPC ready, with some card testing still being done.<ref name="mpc-post" /><ref name="lhamo66-drive" />

[https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RbIk02rDRoJ2sYUBNTXL6r8vtiA5uzq9 Alderaan Operatives], in a folder titled Alderaan Operatives Hangar, was described as fan expansions including ''Unbalanced'', a humorous treatment of the game compared in the post to the ''Magic: The Gathering'' sets Unhinged and Unglued.<ref name="mpc-post" /><ref name="alderaan-drive" />

[[Andy Talaga]]'s drive, listed in the post under the name AndyTalaga and titled SWCCG, was described as fan expansions and Alternate Image cards.<ref name="mpc-post" /><ref name="andytalaga-drive" />

[https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1nVk1598zsS1ZkGwcoB8kXYjgDstP0awd Rechelon's drive], titled SWCCG Custom Locations, was described as remastered locations and a New Republic fan expansion.<ref name="mpc-post" /><ref name="rechelon-drive" />

[https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1hX0GbZ8n_X8nCTtnK-MSzylWJzVF5yPk Swccgfan617's drive], titled swccgfan617's Drive, was described as Kamino, Revenge of the Sith and Battle of Geonosis fan expansions.<ref name="mpc-post" /><ref name="swccgfan617-drive" />

=== Resources ===

The post also lists high-resolution templates for card creation by [[Bardez]], described as upscaled card templates for GIMP, in a Google Drive folder titled [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OsAFQQAhOgUKmKFgFoW1xXGBi-HAJXqJ SWCCG Templates], and a fonts folder titled [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15tTturkmAsXQZXbpU_kmml_RUBQyPkzu SWCCG Fonts], described as the frequently used fonts.<ref name="mpc-post" /><ref name="bardez-drive" /><ref name="fonts-drive" />
